overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole met to review the municipal response and operational challenges of the January 2026 snowstorms before entering executive session to discuss litigation strategy.

items.title: Snow Removal Response and Evaluation (Papers 26-028 and 26-029)
items.summary: The Committee reviewed the DPW Commissioner's report on the January 2026 snowstorm response, focusing on contractor availability, equipment upgrades, and sidewalk clearance, before voting to receive and place the papers on file.

items.title: Executive Session for Litigation Strategy (Papers 26-053 and 26-065)
items.summary: The Committee voted to enter executive session to discuss litigation strategy pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 30A, Section 21A(3).

subject: Snow Removal Response and Litigation Strategy
